note: STRICT table policy. D1 supports `CREATE TABLE ... ) STRICT` (verified against a live D1 instance: a TEXT write into an INTEGER column fails with SQLITE_CONSTRAINT). Without STRICT, SQLite's flexible typing silently stores TEXT in INTEGER columns. drizzle-kit cannot emit STRICT, so any table created or recreated by `pnpm db:generate` needs the keyword added by hand before the migration is committed. scripts/check-strict-tables.cjs enforces this.
